input: Draft a will with an estate planning attorney

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Will With an Estate Planning Attorney
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to work with an estate planning attorney to create a legally valid will.

questions.title: Do you already have an attorney in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has an existing relationship with an estate planning attorney or needs to find one.

questions.title: What state or country will the will be filed in?
questions.description: Identify the jurisdiction, as estate laws and requirements vary significantly by location.

questions.title: What is your target deadline for completing the will?
questions.description: Determine if there is a specific date or urgency driving this task.

questions.title: Do you have a rough estimate of your total estate value?
questions.description: Understand the complexity of the estate to anticipate the scope of work and attorney fees.

questions.title: Have you identified your intended beneficiaries already?
questions.description: Find out if the user knows who they want to leave assets to, which is core to drafting the will.

questions.title: Do you have minor children who need a guardian named?
questions.description: Determine if guardianship designations need to be included, which adds a critical layer to the will.

questions.title: Have you thought about who will be your executor?
questions.description: Find out if the user has considered who will be responsible for carrying out the will's instructions.
